title: RT.DY.------POL.P.
description: Chart on book p. 432 (TRF(CW)-4). RT-DY (reality dynamics) is the subject; POL-P (political policies) is the partner. From CULT-AF-BS: STY (style). From INFO-ALGN: INFO-TRNS (information transference). From INFO-TRNS: IST-F (isolated focus) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From EXP-CONT-1: TRS (transition). From TRS: MT-INFO (multi-information).
